Beyond the course list

  • Overall GPA At least 2.0 overall GPA.
  • Christian/Community Service Satisfy applicable CSER requirements before graduation. These are non-credit obligations.
  • Graduation application Submit the degree completion application during the final anticipated semester.
  • Major course grades At least C in upper-level courses in the major.

Liberty’s transfer rules

  • Up to 90 semester credits from other sources can count toward the 120-credit degree.
  • At least 30 semester credits must be completed at Liberty.
  • At least 30 semester credits must be upper-level.

Source: Liberty residential academic information and policies, 2026–2027

Published full-time university tuition: $12,695 per semester for 12–18 credits in the reviewed band. Fees, housing, meals and other charges are separate. See the rate source.

Questions

Does Sophia English Composition I transfer to Liberty University?

Liberty’s published transfer guidance lists Sophia English Composition I for ENGL 101 Composition and Rhetoric (3 semester credits) in the Psychology (B.S.), with conditions. Ask Liberty to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia Public Speaking transfer to Liberty University?

Liberty’s published transfer guidance lists Sophia Public Speaking for COMS 101 Speech Communication (3 semester credits) in the Psychology (B.S.), with conditions. Ask Liberty to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia English Composition II transfer to Liberty University?

Liberty’s published transfer guidance lists Sophia English Composition II for ENGL 102 Composition and Literature (3 semester credits) in the Psychology (B.S.), with conditions. Ask Liberty to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into Liberty University’s Psychology (B.S.)?

Liberty’s published limit for this 120-credit degree is 90 semester credits from other sources. At least 30 semester credits must be completed at Liberty. This plan proposes 78 semester credits through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Liberty University?

In this plan, 42 semester credits are taken at Liberty, including UNIV 101 Foundational Skills, RLGN 105 Introduction to Biblical Worldview, EVAN 101 Evangelism and the Christian Life, BIBL 105 Old Testament Survey, BIBL 110 New Testament Survey and THEO 201 Theology Survey I and 11 more. Liberty requires at least 30 semester credits at Liberty.

Has Liberty University confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need Liberty’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Ask the school: what is the most ACE- or NCCRS-recommended credit you accept toward this degree? Ask the school for a written transfer evaluation that confirms these courses for your catalog year, including any major-course residency rules. Ask the school to confirm 11 proposed course matches for this exact program before paying for them. Some of the school’s published rules for this program are still being confirmed. Ask the school to confirm this plan before paying for outside courses. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always Liberty’s decisions.
